Water Conservation

Save water without sacrificing comfort

Small fixtures make a big difference. Replacing showerheads, faucet aerators and older toilets with water-efficient models reduces water use every day, and less hot water used means less energy spent heating it.

Request a consultation (555) 010-0199
  • Lower indoor water use for every person in the household
  • Less hot water used, which also reduces water-heating energy

Options

Water Conservation options we offer

Showerhead replacements

Efficient showerheads designed to use less water per minute while keeping a comfortable spray.

Faucet aerators

Simple aerator replacements for kitchen and bathroom faucets that reduce flow without changing how the faucet feels.

Low-flow toilets

High-efficiency toilet replacements that use less water per flush than older models.

Benefits

Why upgrade

  • Lower indoor water use for every person in the household
  • Less hot water used, which also reduces water-heating energy
  • Quick installations with minimal disruption
  • Help understanding water-saving programs that may apply

Is it time?

Signs this upgrade could help

  • Your toilets or fixtures are older models
  • Your water bills are higher than you expect
  • You want quick upgrades that make a difference right away
  • You are already upgrading your water heater

Process

How your water conservation project works

  1. Request a consultation

    Send the form or call us. Tell us about your property and the upgrades you are considering.

  2. Review your options

    We look at your home, explain suitable equipment and fixtures, and answer your questions.

  3. Check program fit

    We point out programs that may apply and what they typically require, before any work begins.

  4. Upgrade & follow up

    We schedule the installation, complete the work and walk you through your new equipment.

Programs

Programs that may apply

Depending on your property and eligibility, these programs may support a water conservation upgrade. We review the current details with you.

  • SoCal WaterSmart
  • SoCalREN
  • MEA

Incentive amounts, eligibility and funding availability are determined by each program and can change. They are not guaranteed. We will review current program information with you before you commit to any work.

FAQ

Water Conservation questions

Will a low-flow showerhead feel weaker?

Modern efficient showerheads are engineered to deliver a comfortable spray at lower flow rates. We can talk through options if you have a preference.

How long do water conservation upgrades take?

Showerhead and aerator replacements are usually quick. Toilet replacements typically take a few hours each. We confirm timing when we schedule your visit.

Can water conservation upgrades lower my energy bill?

Using less hot water at showers and faucets means your water heater runs less, which can reduce energy use as well as water use.
